title: Beyond Automation at OpenAI
summary: Arvind KC, Chief People Officer at OpenAI & former CIO at Palantir, joins Office Hours to discuss the future of the people function. Why efficiency is the wrong frame when model capability doubles every six months. How the people team democratizes AI by amplifying a company's most valuable capability rather than rebuilding the whole org. How span of control shifts from managing seven people to directing hundreds of agents. & why emotional intelligence becomes the leader's edge when intelligence is cheap.

title: Anthropic S-1 Analysis: How 7 Key Metrics Stack Up
summary: Analyze Anthropic's S-1 IPO metrics : $4.6B revenue growing 11.9-fold, a derived 40% gross margin, $974M of operating profit in Q2, & $637B of compute commitments.
